results.rationale: The burger's ingredients and layered structure remain, but the background changes from black to white. The burger is still shown from the front with all layers exposed, unlike the overhead reference dominated by the circular top bun. Thus the requested viewpoint change fails. The rendered burger itself has coherent shapes, textures and lighting.

The leaves, stem and blurred garden remain consistent. The closed bud becomes an open sunflower with a broad brown disk and radiating yellow petals, fulfilling full bloom and the supplied botanical expectation. Petals, disk texture and stem attachment look natural and clean.
